New York: A Global Entry member hid more than $250,000 of Cartier. Customs knew.

Arriving at Philadelphia International from Amsterdam, 25 October, she claimed a few thousand in souvenirs. Officers knew: a $183,818 bracelet, a $67,811 ring. She admitted discarding receipts.

CBP took her Global Entry membership. Hiding over $800 can bring punishment.
